name: Rimath Hospitality Company
summary: Headquartered in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and established in 1925, Intelligent Oud Co. is a company dedicated to the formulation, manufacturing, and supply of incenses, perfumes, and cosmetics. These diverse product lines are distributed across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Italy, primarily trading under the iOud, O'SO, and Thannah labels.
